'''Tadeusz Iwaniec''' (born October 9, 1947 in [[Elbląg]]) is a [[Poland|Polish]]-[[United States|American]] [[mathematician]], and since 1996 John Raymond French Distinguished Professor of Mathematics at [[Syracuse University]].<ref name="syrbio">[http://math.syr.edu/Bios/IwaniecBio.htm Biography of Tadeusz Iwaniec], Mathematics Department, Syracuse University. Retrieved 2010-01-22.</ref>

He and mathematician [[Henryk Iwaniec]] are twin brothers.

==Awards and honors==
Iwaniec was given the Prize of the President of the Polish Academy of Sciences, 1980, the Alfred Jurzykowski Award in Mathematics in 1997, the Prix 2001 Institut Henri-Poincaré Gauthier-Villars,<ref name="syrbio"/> and the 2009 Sierpinski Medal of the Polish Mathematical Society and Warsaw University.<ref>SU math professor gets international honor, ''Syracuse Post-Standard'', March 26, 2009.</ref> In 1998 he was elected as a foreign member of the Academia di Scienze Fisiche e Matematiche, Italy <ref name="syrbio"/> and in 2012 as a foreign member of the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>[http://www.acadsci.fi/jasenet/uudet_jasenet.htm New Members.] [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]]. Accessed May 24, 2012.</ref>
